case study · 05 / 05

ChurnSight

An in-progress churn analysis project pairing a model with feature explanations.

PythonXGBoostSHAPStreamlit

private repo　private repo

outcomes

XGBoost modelSHAP explanationsStreamlit interface

problem

A churn score alone does not explain which subscriber signals deserve attention. ChurnSight is being built to pair classification with interpretable feature contributions.

architecture

decisions · why · trade-offs

Pair XGBoost with SHAP.

The model score needs feature-level context for review.

Trade-off accepted: Explanations describe model behaviour, not causal drivers.

Use Streamlit for the analysis interface.

It provides a direct way to inspect model outputs during development.

Trade-off accepted: The project remains an analysis tool rather than a production system.

Keep the project marked as in progress.

The source résumé says it is being built.

Trade-off accepted: No shipped-product claim is made.

result

  • Building an explainable churn analysis workflow.
  • Uses XGBoost, SHAP, and Streamlit.

if I kept going…

  • Validate the model against a held-out dataset.
  • Inspect explanation stability across subscriber segments.
